summary: Researched ASML after its 2026-07-28 lower-Bollinger transition. The USD 1,590.18 close fell 15.45% over the observation period and finished 2.18% below the lower band, but RSI was not oversold and volume was not abnormal. Current SEC-filed Q2 evidence shows EUR 9.3265 billion of revenue, 54.0% gross margin, EUR 2.9176 billion of net income, net liquidity, and sharply raised 2026 guidance, with no new operating impairment explaining the decline. A bounded 12-month earnings sensitivity gives 31.4% downside and only 8.7% base upside, so the move is valuation and timing risk rather than a sufficient paper-trade opportunity. Established medium-confidence baseline eligibility, created no conviction strategy, and created no idea refresh because neither the payload nor an accepted canonical relationship names an idea.

evidence.source: PaperTrader deterministic market, indicator, and FX caches
evidence.claim: ASML closed at USD 1,590.18 on 2026-07-28, down 15.45% from 2026-06-29 and 9.33% over the final two sessions. The close was 2.18% below the USD 1,625.64 lower Bollinger band; RSI was 37.35, volume anomaly was 0.82, and bollinger_below_lower was the only transition. The canonical source-price hash is 03461855cc0d161211343f15bfd344f9a6dc5276a1edc50de8d288d2d7b11ef3. At the same-date USD/EUR rate of 0.87955, the mark was about EUR 1,398.64; EUR 960 downside and EUR 1,520 base values convert to USD 1,091.47 and USD 1,728.16, implying -31.4% and +8.7%.

The July 15 SEC filing reports Q2 total net sales of EUR 9.3 billion and net income of EUR 2.9 billion and raises the 2026 outlook to EUR 43-45 billion of revenue with 54%-56% gross margin. It confirms strong AI-led demand and does not identify a new operating impairment behind the July 27-28 decline.

evidence.source: ASML Holding N.V. Q2 2026 US GAAP financial statements
evidence.claim: The filed statements report EUR 9.3265 billion of Q2 revenue, 54.0% gross margin, EUR 2.9176 billion of net income, EUR 7.58 diluted EPS, and 384.9 million diluted weighted-average shares. Cash plus short-term investments were EUR 7.5815 billion versus EUR 1.9844 billion of long-term debt, while negative first-half operating cash flow preserves working-capital conversion as contrary evidence.

daily_report_items: ASML's 2026-07-28 lower-Bollinger breach followed a 15.45% one-month decline but lacked oversold RSI or abnormal-volume confirmation. SEC-filed Q2 results and raised guidance support the operating thesis, while bounded USD 1,091.47 downside and USD 1,728.16 base values imply -31.4% and +8.7% from the USD 1,590.18 mark; the move is valuation and timing risk, not a conviction paper-trade opportunity.
